messages:
Riley: quick heads-up - planning the "Neon Cascade" launch nurture for webinar + benchmark download leads. target = 2-email mini-drip (welcome + playbook) + a 1-week reminder for webinar registrants. need segmentation, send windows, and a lightweight holdout. thoughts?
Maya: sounds good. suggest segments: webinar-reg, benchmark-download, trial-signup. we should be careful about duplicate leads across sources (prefer most-recent).
Ethan: Content POV - Email1 = welcome + 1-click benchmark snapshot; Email2 (3 days) = short playbook + CTA to schedule a walkthrough. For webinar regs add conditional block with calendar RSVP.
Lina: deliverability notes: suppression list check, recent hard bounces >30d out, and seed list test. also add List-Unsubscribe header and clickable unsubscribe at top for legal.
Maya: send windows: EU 9-11am local, NA 10-1pm PT, APAC 11am-2pm JST. throttling: 150/min initial with dynamic ramp.
Riley: Measurement - include a 5% randomized holdout across all lead_sources to measure lift. track conversion events: neon_welcome_open, neon_playbook_click, neon_demo_booked. baseline window = 14 days.
Ethan: Subject A/B test for Email1: A) "Neon benchmark ready: quick snapshot" B) "Welcome to Redwood — your benchmark is waiting". Preview text variants: latency-first vs cost-first. run in parallel within each segment.
Maya: here's the SQL for the main cohort (ops please use last_activity tie-breaker):
```
SELECT id, email FROM leads
WHERE lead_source IN ('webinar-reg','benchmark-download','trial-signup')
  AND created_at >= '2026-02-15'
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND bounce_status != 'hard'
ORDER BY last_activity DESC
```
Lina: ops checklist - add seed recipients: product@redwood.ai, qa@redwood.ai; staging send tested; SPF/DKIM verified for campaign domain (rwd.ai). Also flag enterprise domain group to include dedicated-capacity CTA for trial-signup segment.
Riley: cadence: immediate welcome, email2 at +72 hours, webinar reminder at +7 days only for webinar-reg. backfill? yes, run one-off backfill for missed downloads but tag as backfill=true and send at low rate.
ops-bot: Campaign "neon-cascade-nurture" created. schedule=1768010000, rate=150/min, segments=3, holdout=5%, backfill_job=ready.
Ethan: I'll drop copy in the campaign doc and add conditional blocks for enterprise CTA and webinar RSVP.
Maya: analytics - set utm_campaign=neon-cascade, utm_source=welcome-drip, and include hashed_user_id param in links. create dashboard tile for 24h open and 7d conversion.
Lina: one more: blacklist any users with more than 3 soft bounces in 30 days. also run seed send for APAC timezone verification.
Riley: perfect. plan to finalize copy by EOD and schedule if all tests green. post-launch check-in tomorrow 10am PT to review 0-24h metrics. :rocket:
